parsed.answer: I couldn't find a past ticket that reports this same problem. None of the archived tickets ask about the VSTT\17.0\UITestExtensionPackages reference path in Host.Tests.UIA not existing on disk. Terminal#12219 and terminal#1297 are related only in that Host.Tests.UIA is a .NET Framework project that can produce reference or build problems. In terminal#12219 a contributor said the UIA test projects (Host.Tests.UIA among them) are not needed to build Cascadia, and that you can just build the CascadiaPackage project instead of the whole solution. If you only want to build or run Terminal, that is the safest route. Don't delete the path value from the project. It is probably a reference to the Visual Studio test extension package location that only exists when the relevant VS test components are installed. If you need the UIA tests, try installing the Visual Studio workloads or components for UI testing, then reload the solution. Otherwise, please file or keep this ticket open so the team can confirm.
